content_of_post_to_answer: Why does anxiety make it difficult to relax when I know I'm safe?
answer: Anxiety often persists because the brain is not only asking “Am I safe?” but also “Can I stop monitoring for danger?” Those are different systems. Logical reassurance can convince the thinking mind while the threat-detection system is still running its old program. I’ve written more about this pattern on my profile for anyone wanting a deeper look. Relaxation becomes easier when we stop treating anxiety as proof of danger and start seeing it as an overprotective alarm.
